findings.message: Warranty at `$['data']['offers'][0]['warranty']` states neither a duration nor a description.
findings.remediation: State the warranty as written in `description`, and add `durationOfWarranty` where a finite length is stated. A lifetime warranty carries `description` (and optionally `name`) with no `durationOfWarranty`.
